items.title: Rebuild the cloud environment snapshot
steps: In any cloud session, open the environment menu in the session's title bar.
Choose Edit, then Setup script.
Save with no change; that rebuilds the snapshot.
Mark done. It is done when a new session starts without the EXECPATH line.
